market_summary: USD and BTC exhibit strong directional pressure heading into the London/NY crossover, with BTCUSD heavily breaking below Value Area Low and GBPUSD rolling over through VWAP with confirmed RVOL and bearish CVD. EURUSD and US100 remain range-bound within their respective Value Areas awaiting NY cash open catalysts.

With price inside VA and CVD neutral, best action is HOLD.

Evaluating the 7 confluence factors: 1) Volume Profile: Price is inside Value Area (VAL 1.32611 to VAH 1.32797) and below POC (1.32738), leaning toward lower boundary. 2) CVD: Bearish at -4,133 with negative slope (-758.39), agreeing with downside pressure. 3) Session: London session. 4) Trend: Signal candle closed just above VWAP (1.32673) but live price (1.32647) is breaking below VWAP, EMA20 (1.32693), and EMA50 (1.32700). 5) ATR: Mid-to-lower channel, pressing toward lower ATR band at 1.32570. 6) RVOL: Last closed bar had a confirmed RVOL spike of 2.158 with clear selling wick. 7) Levels: Testing intermediate support at S/R 1.32661 and Prev Low 1.32618. Bearish confluence is developing with CVD alignment and RVOL spike.
